note: Village of Warner campground on village land, operated by the Warner Lions Club, next to the community playground (~65 km south of Lethbridge). Treed sites. Long-term stays are not offered, and after 14 days campers move to another site. --Claude
summary: Village page confirms C$30 a night, first come first served, 30/20-amp power and water at every site (partial hookups: sewer false), flush toilet, dump, pull-throughs, no long-term stays; Council Policy 702 adds the 14-day move rule, 12 p.m. check-out and one vehicle overnight. Site count 9 (derived) is not on the current page; left. Pin on the loop (~50 m). Phone and website confirmed.
flags: OWNERSHIP local confirmed: Council Policy 702 calls it 'the municipally owned campground' (Warner Lions Campground); the Lions run it. Google Maps 'Warner RV Park' 4.3 from 9 reviews, phone +1 403-934-0673, website the Lions Facebook page.
PHONE 403-934-0673 matches the page ('contact Rodney Punga at 403-934-0673'). WEBSITE https://www.warner.ca/p/warner-lions-rv-park answered 200 and is this campground.
SITE COUNT: stored 9 (derived from note prose); the current village page gives no count. On imagery the oval loop NW of the playground shows roughly 8-10 diagonal pads; left unchanged.
SEASON: the village page and Policy 702 give no dates; left unset.
PIN (49.28410,-112.20470): at the south mouth of the campground loop by the playground, ~50 m from the loop's centre (Google 49.28414,-112.20529). OK.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed - no water near; railway and highway to the NE.
